assessment.rationale: The json_output module is already well-designed with JsonResponse type, next_actions support, and helper functions. The infrastructure exists - we just need to ensure all commands use it consistently.

success_criteria: Consistent ActionResult schema across all outputs
next_actions field populated with relevant workflow suggestions
Machine-readable error messages in JSON format
All KIRK commands return structured action metadata
notes: The json_output module already has all necessary types (JsonResponse, NextAction, JsonError, JsonMetadata). Commands like quality, coverage, gaps, invert, effects already return json_output.JsonResponse. We just need to verify consistency and ensure next_actions are populated intelligently.
